summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'click photo to toggle rust box' feature on the Rust Preventing ASTM D1748 Result page (OverlayCard.clickPhoto + figure.js hitBox). Tested seeded demo record RUST-DEMO-079 (id cb4b0d7f-ef86-42b9-a0ad-ce84282d87f4, method=full, 79/100, Grade E). Every expected behavior passed: (1) tab SELURUH FOTO shows RESMI badge; (2) clicking the overlay photo at box 51 and box 61 positions toggles those boxes off, auto-switches rust-overlay-view from AI to KOREKSI, and live indicators (rust-overlay-live-count=77/100, rust-overlay-live-grade=E) + top summary (rust-result-count=77, rust-result-grade=E) update in sync; (3) grade transitions follow ASTM D1748 thresholds exactly as count decreases via rust-grid-box-N clicks — 50/D at count 50, 25/C at count 25, 10/B at count 10, 0/A at count 0; (4) clicking a clean box on the photo (box 1) adds it back as rusted (count went 0 -> 1); (5) RESET KE AI restores exactly 79/E; (6) SIMPAN KOREKSI (rust-overlay-save) persists after reload — reloaded page showed KOREKSI GRID verdict 78/100 · E while AI VISION · SELURUH FOTO verdict still read 79/100 · E (AI original preserved); (7) seed restored at the end via RESET KE AI + SIMPAN KOREKSI GRID -> post-reload 79/E. Footer legend (bottom 54px of overlay image) correctly treated as outside the grid — hitBox returns -1 there (verified indirectly: no stray toggles observed when clicking inside grid area only). No console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: renderOverlay returns geom.h = ch + footer, but hitBox only hits inside the quad which (for method=full) is 0..ch — correct, footer is implicitly excluded. For method=zone with cropped zoom, the quad is scaled inside the image and the dim-outside overlay plus hitBox's inPoly keep clicks outside the measuring zone as no-ops. Behavior is correct.
OverlayCard.clickPhoto guards non-official methods with a toast and does not call onToggle — safe. For an un-analyzed method, snap is undefined and function returns early.
Minor: Result.jsx is now ~325 lines with 3 subcomponents (OverlayCard, InspectorCard, MethodDetail). Still readable, but splitting OverlayCard into its own file would help future maintenance.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Mutated the seeded record RUST-DEMO-079 temporarily during the SIMPAN KOREKSI persistence test, then restored to the AI baseline (first 79 boxes true, grade E) via RESET KE AI + SIMPAN KOREKSI GRID. Verified post-reload the record is back to 79/E.
